research_notes: Follow up named law-firm employers and hours, education-department service/leave records, dated school transfers and relief-work employers. Resolve continuity of the full-time 2012–2022 teaching period before counting it; earlier hours remain unknown.

APH's 1993–2022 teaching range encloses a legal-career interruption, not 29 continuous public-sector years. No overlap is summed. University-era jobs, leave, relief teaching and legal practice are separate evidence gaps.

The 2022 interview's twelve-year full-time-teaching description is broad narrative; its implied 2010 start conflicts with primary evidence of returning to teaching in 2012. Full-time status is supported, but exact continuous duration is not. Party volunteer work must not be counted as a second full-time job.

Searched official biography and first speech, party historical annual-report material, school-domain and annual-report searches, union material, legal-employer terms, ABC profiles and public professional-profile results. LinkedIn retrieval returned 429; no bypass attempted. APH speech returned 403; party transcript available. No reliable named firm or precise full-time service chronology retrieved. Last follow-up 2026-09-29.

Further leads: school annual reports/personnel notices for Kenmore, Bundaberg, Cleveland and Gladstone; archived national-firm professional-indemnity staff lists from 2007–2012; law qualification chronology. Missing pay/hours are unknown, not zero.

2026-10-02 follow-up: searched Penny/Penelope Allman-Payne with solicitor, law firm, marine insurance, 2009, Clayton Utz, DLA and Ebsworth, and QTU historical material. No attributable named legal employer, law-practice hours or dated school/payroll/leave record was located. Existing ABC 2013 and first-speech accounts remain the evidence; search absence is not proof of no employment. Public LinkedIn https://au.linkedin.com/in/penny-allman-payne-727695242 returned (999) Unknown Status Code via web open; indexed summary only identifies teacher/lawyer/activist and does not expose earlier employers. No access controls bypassed. Advance to next member; revisit with a named legal-employer or dated school archive lead, retaining all existing gaps. No material new career fact found; excluded from enrichment count.

2026-10-03 follow-up: employer-domain and school-archive searching recovered Gladstone State High School's primary 2022 student planner, which lists Penny Allman-Payne as a HASS and Languages contact. This materially resolves the previously generic later Gladstone employer and records contemporaneous subject-area duties. It remains a point-in-time source: no continuous 2018–2022 interval, full-year service, payroll hours, leave, transfer date, exact Cleveland school, earlier Gladstone school or law-firm name is inferred. Retain blocked status and no headline total.
